messages:
anya_cs: Heads-up  Velora Systems usage dropped ~82% in the last 24h. Their onboarding PM, Priya, said nightly scoring jobs haven't run since Monday. Billing looks steady but activity is near zero. They mentioned a competitor PoC spinning up this week.
matt_csm: I pulled ticket VS-2310. Customer reports timeouts and increased tail latency after we enabled stricter retention for request logs. They said procurement wants a remediation plan before the EOM. I reached out to Priya and the new Head of Data (Jared) but no reply yet. :telephone_receiver:
devon_solutions: I offered an immediate 30-min troubleshooting session and temporary elevated logging for their tenant. They asked for a short one-pager describing rollback/containment options and a short commercial safety (timeboxed trial) we can offer.
paul_eng: From traces: queueing spikes during log-flush windows, plus some 504s for long-running batch score jobs. Quick excerpt to share:
```
2025-05-02T03:14:22Z JOB run-338 FAILED -> 504 Gateway Timeout
trace: batching-queue -> log-flush-lock -> backend-timeout
metrics: qlen=312, p95=1.8s -> p99=12.6s
```
We suspect retention-backed compaction is contending with hot request paths. If they approve, we can disable aggressive compaction for their tenant and re-route batch jobs to a warmed pool. ETA ~3-5h to stage change.
anya_cs: Copy of Priya's note in VS-2310: "Since the log retention change, throughput dropped and our scoring SLA missed. We're running a short evaluation of vendor X this week and procurement expects a recovery plan by Friday."
matt_csm: Competitor PoC + new Head of Data = high churn risk. Sales asked whether we can offer a 10-day dedicated pool for their critical scoring jobs while we fix the compaction issue. Keep it timeboxed and attach a mitigation acknowledgement.
devon_solutions: Agree to 10-day dedicated bridge if procurement signs a time-limited acceptance. We'll include an ops playbook: disable compaction, warm KV caches, route batch jobs to dedicated pool, and run masked replay of 5k requests. No long-term discounts.
paul_eng: Technical steps to include in the playbook:
- Toggle retention-compaction=off for tenant velora (non-disruptive toggle).
- Provision warm pool size 2x for batch windows and migrate jobs.
- Run masked replay; capture failing inputs.
- Restore compaction in staged increments after validation.
We need approval and a contact who can run the replay.
anya_cs: Action list for thread: 1) Matt loop Sales and draft the mitigation ack + 10-day bridge offer. 2) Devon prepare the one-pager and ops playbook. 3) Paul stage the compaction toggle and warm pool config (standby). 4) Anya schedule a 45-min triage with Velora (preferably Jared + Priya) for tomorrow 11:00 their timezone.
sales-bot: Sales notified: potential timeboxed bridge offer queued for review (req #BR-987)
matt_csm: I'll ping procurement contact marie@velora and Jared. If we don't hear back in 6h, escalate to GTM lead. I'll draft the mitigation ack like: "Redwood will provision a 10-day dedicated pool for specified endpoints while engineering performs targeted remediation. Customer agrees to provide masked replay data and accepts scope/timebox." Any wording tweaks?
devon_solutions: Add clause that the bridge is contingent on the replay/runbook and that we will collect metrics for post-mortem. Also require acceptance of no additional discounts beyond the timebox.
paul_eng: Once we have sign-off I'll flip the compaction toggle in staging and run the smoke replay. ETA to get to staging ~2h, to prod change after customer approval ~1h.
anya_cs: I'll send the invite now for 11:00. Devon, drop the one-pager in the ticket. Matt, attach the mitigation ack to VS-2310. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
matt_csm: Drafted mitigation ack and uploaded to VS-2310. Pinged marie@velora and jared@velora. Marking as high priority.
anya_cs: If we get acceptance, we'll also offer a short exec call to Velora's CTO to reassure procurement. Keep thread posted.
